notes: The session's web-search allowance ran out after a few searches, so most pages were opened directly: the Utah Courts' judge pages, the Lieutenant Governor's 2026 Voter Information Pamphlet (vote.utah.gov, official; its candidate rows print each campaign's website and its judicial retention pages print the Judicial Performance Evaluation Commission's evaluations), the Utah Republican Party's 2026 candidate page, county Democratic parties' candidate pages (to find a campaign address only), and the campaign sites themselves. A website is listed only where the campaign site itself was opened and names the candidate and the district.

Pairing a pamphlet row with its website: the pamphlet prints the website a line above or on the candidate's own row; a website a full row away belongs to the neighbouring candidate and was not used. No website is printed in the pamphlet for Brady Brammer, Mark A. Strong, Troy Shelley, Glenn D Webb or Jared Neal; their sites were found on the Utah Republican Party's page (Brammer, Strong, Shelley), the Washington County Democratic Party's page (Webb) and the Davis County Democratic Party's page (Neal), and then opened.

Refused the reader, so nothing was taken from it and nothing was worked around: carl.vote (Carl R. Albrecht's address in the pamphlet) answers with a SiteGround CAPTCHA redirect. ryanmahoney4utah.com does not exist; the Utah Republican Party's 'ryanmahoney4utah' is the godaddysites address the pamphlet prints.

Read and left out on purpose: jobs (deputy county attorney, chief deputy county attorney, law clerk, Special Assistant U.S. Attorney, guardian ad litem attorney, union treasurer and business agent, college and university posts), Kirk M. Morgan's 'Brigham City Attorney' (no years, and a small city's attorney is often a contracted practice: left for a person to judge), Sarah Reale's 'Salt Lake Library Board of Directors' (the site does not say which library or when), party posts (Ryan L. Mahoney's county delegate, precinct chair and Salt Lake County GOP regional chair), and Sarah Reale's endorsements by Democratic clubs and caucuses (not the party's own endorsement). No Utah party page names any of these candidates as endorsed (see ballot/lean/ut_endorsements.json), so there is no endorsed_by entry.

Cabot Nelson's site says this is his fifth campaign, with the United Utah Party and now the Forward Party; no official result page was opened for the earlier runs (no search allowance), so past_party is empty and only his own words are kept.

Privacy, for John's information: while pairing pamphlet rows with websites, the working output printed the campaign e-mail addresses that share a row with the website for Jim Alvey, Scott Troxel, Sarah Reale and Nelson Abbott, and a snippet of Kristina Robinson's campaign page that names the town she lives in. None of it is stored anywhere; the pamphlet's text was kept only in the session's scratch folder.
Nothing found beyond what they filed for Iva Williams's offices, Sergio Sotelo, Glenn D Webb, Jim Alvey, Scott Troxel and Brandon Young's offices; no birth year was found for anyone in this part.
